decision: Retain Apple FP32. Preserve this candidate as an explicit experiment; the measured gain missed the minimum 10 percent threshold.
platform: Apple M5 Max host used by the earlier Apple campaigns
implementation: Packed-only production activations with bounded time panels
Shared packed input for the Up4 projections
Four fused late decoder regions using Apple NEON/vForce and SME2
Same 22 selected INT8 products, nine FP32 products, weights, quantization axes, scales and full-K accumulation

validation.scope: Decoder changes only. Exact equality is against previous Apple INT8, not FP32.

timing_protocol.rtf_denominator: Complete generated waveform samples / native model sample rate, including documented right padding
timing_protocol.fp32_gate: Original atol1e-5/rtol1e-4 vs frozen reference and fresh stock
timing_protocol.int8_gate: Original atol1e-5/rtol1e-4 vs separately pinned r3 INT8; bitwise recorded. No INT8-to-FP32 allclose gate.
timing_protocol.state_checks: Every validated clip uses real lengths:base=min(65,L),prefix=min(33,base),futurecut=min(32,base-1),repeat,concurrent distinct-input length=min(31,otherL); first clip also valid boundary lengths/cuts. Actual lengths recorded.
timing_protocol.timing: FP32/INT8 adjacent, balanced randomized pair order; stock/Mimi shuffled around pair. Hashes/checks/host observations outside timers.
timing_protocol.reference_session: r3 held during validation and released before warmups; its native libraries may remain mapped

timing_summary.primary_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-clip mean decoder RTFs; every selected clip has equal weight
timing_summary.corpus_aggregation: Total elapsed / total generated duration reported separately

paired.ci_scope: Paired repeat blocks preserve shared drift across clips; hierarchical interval additionally resamples clips. Five repeats and ten selected clips give limited inference.

quality.source: 60 FLEURS clips, six per language across ten languages
quality.metric_bandwidth: Common 16 kHz source band; unchanged resampling, no level normalization, documented right padding trimmed

absolute_quality.aggregation: Equal mean across language means; each language mean is unweighted over utterances. No duration weighting.

quality.interpretation: This port adds no waveform change versus previous Apple INT8 on the tested corpus. Existing INT8 approximation still has small measured differences from FP32. No new listening panel or standardized MUSHRA score.

diagnostic.scope: Two warmups and one selected profiled forward per model; excluded from headline RTF
diagnostic.limitation: Fused/custom operators combine matrix work, packing, nonlinearities, copies and halos. Their durations do not isolate Snake, depthwise convolution or SME. Profiled baseline/candidate differences are not speedup evidence.

host_limits: Paired timing retained every observation; no process priority or power settings were changed.
Process and hardware inventory queries were denied. Thermal queries returned error text, so idle or unthrottled operation is not established.
AC Power was reported while battery percentage fell; low power mode was reported as off.
Historical Apple controls also have substantially different absolute RTF. Do not attribute old-to-new absolute RTF changes to this candidate.
corrections_before_final_run: FP32 helper internal tile bounded to 256 while fused stage tile remains 512.
Four short Mimi clips use their real latent lengths in state probes. No source padding, corpus changes or tolerance relaxation. The first run stopped before collecting any timing.
